_comment: Committed as data (not runs/, which is gitignored) so notebooks/tour_de_gross/
wave5_lpu_ops_report.ipynb section 5 renders without a production run.
These are the fail-fast VALIDATION numbers at reduced geometry (C=3, d_init=2),
NOT the production campaign (C=10, d_init=12) -- that has not been run.

failure_spectrum._what: f(w) = fraction of weight-w fault configurations the decoder gets wrong. p-INDEPENDENT.
_reading: Totals per 2400: y1 5, inter pre-fix 2, inter+closure 4 -- statistically
indistinguishable. The BASELINE IS ITSELF NONZERO at w=3,4,6 (decoder
miscorrection at the cheap 20-set relay, not undetectable errors), so the
standard is 'matches the baseline', NEVER 'identically zero'.
Resolution is ~1/T = 2.5e-3: a clean 0/400 BOUNDS the floor, it does not
disprove one. Ruling out the ~5e-4-class floor needs T >~ 10000.

expected_faults_per_shot._what: DEM fault mass, decoder-independent. Why MC LER at p_ref cannot diagnose obs0.

monte_carlo_ler._what: The measurements that produced -- and then retired -- the reported obs0 'floor'.
_reading: The known-good Y1 baseline floors just as hard as the inter-module circuit at
p=5e-3. At ~106 expected faults/shot against d~10, LER~0.5 is arithmetically
unavoidable for ANY circuit of this size. The inter-module circuit drops to
0.02 at p=1e-3 -- a threshold crossing, not a floor.

production_sizing._what: Idle-ON sizing probe that froze weights_range. Analytic from the DEM, no decoding.
production_sizing.formula: w_hi = ceil(mu_max + 4*sqrt(mu_max)),  mu = N_expanded * q_base * p / p_ref
production_sizing._reading: The old [1,900] PLACEHOLDER stopped short of the dominant p_hi mass at w~1518-1583.
